trigger.error: phylo.maker status counts disagree with frozen vectorized crosswalk

diagnosis.package_rule: Before normalization or status assignment, phylo.maker removes duplicated sp.list$species and keeps the first supplied row.
diagnosis.old_vectorized_rule: Counted DISTINCT species,genus rows; categorical mode eligibility was also grouped by species,genus,value.
diagnosis.consequence: A binomial represented with more than one genus string could be counted more than once by the vectorized crosswalk while phylo.maker retained only one species row.

semantic_species_rule.numeric: one eligible row per raw binomial after numeric/unit validity; genus is not part of species identity
semantic_species_rule.categorical: compute modal category by raw binomial exactly as v0.3 semantic gate; keep only unique-mode species

corrected_equivalence.taxonomic_row_rule: For every eligible raw binomial, attach one deterministic genus = lexicographically smallest nonempty genus among eligible records for that species; family is the fixed candidate family.
corrected_equivalence.package_input_order: Sort by raw species, genus before writing the species table; because one row per species remains, phylo.maker's duplicated-species removal is idempotent.
corrected_equivalence.status_rule: Then apply the already-frozen normalized species/genus/family prune-bind-fail logic.

required_recomputation: v0.4 crosswalk for all 3,593 semantic-PASS systems
v0.6.2 informativeness on the corrected core
